title: T1: Advancing Language Model Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning and Inference Scaling
venue: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025), PMLR 267
authors_zh: Zhenyu Hou、Xin Lv、Rui Lu、Jiajie Zhang、Yujiang Li、Zijun Yao、Juanzi Li、Jie Tang、Yuxiao Dong
paper_type_zh: 数学推理数据构造、答案核验强化学习与推理时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要设计 RLVR、长推理轨迹、rollout 多样性或推理预算实验，并希望审计公开训练数据边界的研究者
one_line: T1 synthesizes trial-and-error/self-verification math chains for SFT and applies answer-verified, high-temperature 64-rollout RLOO to study training and inference scaling, but public release semantics, lineage, and replay remain incomplete.
T1 将公开数学题构造成含试错与自我核查的推理链，用答案核验的 64-rollout RLOO 研究训练和推理时扩展；但公开数据的语义、谱系与可复现性仍不完整。
why: It is a concrete evidence source for coupling long reasoning traces with outcome verification and diversity-oriented RL; it is not yet a self-contained, auditable training dataset because the public files lack documented lineage, schema semantics, and verifier decisions.
inclusion_reason: A reasoning-data construction and RLVR case study: it turns answer-checked math problems into synthesized self-correcting chains, then studies high-temperature multi-rollout RL and inference-budget scaling. It belongs in rollout/search test-time trace data because its core object is a long reasoning trace with answer-level verification, not a process-label release.

title: Problem
问题
html:
T1 is an ICML 2025 paper in PMLR 267 about how to obtain and exploit longer mathematical-reasoning behavior without treating a benchmark score as evidence that a training dataset is sound. Its primary record is the PMLR proceedings paper; OpenReview records it as an ICML 2025 poster. The paper is relevant to rollout_search_test_time_trace_data because its central training/evaluation surface is a long textual trace sampled many times under an answer-level verifier, followed by an analysis of more inference tokens—not a step-labeled process-reward dataset.

The construction starts with public MATH-train and NuminaMath problems. An intended SFT example is a question plus an LLM-synthesized chain containing several solution attempts, answer-grounded feedback, and a merged final solution. An RL item is a filtered math prompt whose completions receive a final-answer correctness signal. This gives the Atlas a concrete data object and feedback contract: public questions, synthetic process text, and outcome verification. It does not provide a tool-using environment, a human annotation protocol, or released per-step correctness labels.

The decision boundary is important. This card covers the recipe and its public artifact, not a claim that the available files are ready for direct training reuse. The paper reports roughly 12,000 SFT questions and 30,000 RL questions, whereas the current dataset repository exposes two heterogeneous JSONL files without a documented mapping back to those counts, rows, or experiments. That gap is why this is an L4 reading/audit card with partial status rather than an endorsement of the release. (Paper Appendix A; official Hugging Face dataset, checked 2026-07-23.)

T1 是收录于 PMLR 267 的 ICML 2025 论文，讨论如何获得并利用更长的数学推理行为；它并不把 benchmark 分数当作训练数据可靠性的证明。PMLR proceedings 是主要论文入口，OpenReview 将其记录为 ICML 2025 poster。它归入 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data，因为其核心训练/评估表面是：在答案级 verifier 下多次采样长文本推理轨迹，并分析更多推理 token 的作用；它不是一个带逐步标签的 process-reward 数据集。

构造从公开的 MATH-train 与 NuminaMath 题目开始。预期的一条 SFT 样本由题目、若干解题尝试、基于答案的反馈以及合并后的最终解答组成，且这些过程文本由 LLM 合成。一条 RL 样本则是经过筛选的数学 prompt，其 completion 接收最终答案正确性信号。因此，本卡可以明确其数据对象与反馈契约：公开题目、合成过程文本、结果核验。论文没有提供工具调用环境、人工标注协议或已发布的逐步正确性标签。

边界必须保留。此卡覆盖的是方法与公开 artifact，而不是宣称现有文件可以直接用于训练。论文称约有 12,000 个 SFT 题目和 30,000 个 RL 题目；当前数据仓库却只有两个 schema 不同的 JSONL 文件，未说明它们如何对应这些计数、具体行或实验。因此本卡是 partial 的 L4 阅读/审计资料，而非对该发布的背书。（论文 Appendix A；官方 Hugging Face 数据集，2026-07-23 检查。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a coupled recipe: first synthesize SFT reasoning chains that expose trial, error, and self-verification; then make RL exploration deliberately diverse with high-temperature multi-rollout sampling, answer-level reward, RLOO normalization, entropy regularization, and a normalized-KL/EMA anchor. The authors also study a separate inference-scaling procedure that truncates a long completion at successive 10% prefixes and has the base model summarize/finalize each prefix. (Paper §§3.1–3.3.)

The observable feedback is narrow but concrete. Candidate final answers can be compared with known math labels, so the reported RL reward is 1 for correct and 0 for incorrect; detected pathological responses receive -1. The contract cannot observe whether every intermediate step is valid, whether a correct-looking answer used sound reasoning, or whether the parser accepts every equivalent mathematical form. The SFT chain's critiques are synthetic LLM text rather than separately released human or verifier annotations.

Closest comparisons are ordinary outcome-reward RL on math and test-time sampling/scaling. T1's stated difference is not a new ground-truth verifier: it combines an error-aware trace-synthesis pattern with high-temperature, 64-way rollout exploration and analyzes long-chain inference budgets. For the Atlas, the direction signal is the coupling of trace form, outcome reward, and sampling diversity; users should still audit the trace generator and release before interpreting it as a process-supervision resource.

其贡献是一套耦合配方：先合成显式包含尝试、错误与自我核查的 SFT 推理链；再以高温多 rollout 采样、答案级 reward、RLOO 归一化、entropy regularization 和 normalized-KL/EMA anchor 进行有意保持多样性的 RL。作者还研究了独立的 inference scaling：将一个长 completion 按每 10% 的前缀截断，让 base model 对各前缀进行总结/作答。（论文 §§3.1–3.3。）

可观察的反馈既明确也很窄。候选最终答案可与已知数学标签比对，所以 RL 中正确为 1、错误为 0；被发现有病态模式的回复为 -1。该契约无法观察每一步是否正确、一个表面正确的答案是否有可靠推理，或解析器能否接受所有等价数学表达式。SFT 链中的 critique 是合成的 LLM 文本，不是另行发布的人类或 verifier 标注。

最接近的比较对象是常规数学 outcome-reward RL 与 test-time sampling/scaling。T1 声称的不同点并不是新的 ground-truth verifier，而是把带错误的轨迹合成模式、64 路高温 rollout 探索与长链推理预算分析结合起来。对 Atlas 而言，方向信号是轨迹形式、结果 reward 与采样多样性的耦合；在将它视为 process supervision 资源前，仍须审计 trace generator 与发布物。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs → construction → feedback → selection → use are as follows. Start with MATH-train and NuminaMath. For each SFT question, collect multiple answers from unspecified LLMs; compare each with the label; request a critique of an incorrect answer or verification of a correct one; merge the problem, attempts, and feedback into one chain; rewrite mere enumeration into a trial-and-error abstraction. The authors filter noisy/inaccurate labels and easy problems. For RL-prompt selection they sample 16 answers and retain questions with pass rate strictly between 0 and 0.3, yielding the reported 30k prompt pool. (Appendix A.)

For RL, sample K=64 responses per retained prompt at high temperature. Give final-answer correctness reward 1/0, apply -1 to selected bad responses, normalize rewards with leave-one-out RLOO, add entropy, and use a KL term normalized across rollouts against an EMA reference policy. Updates are reported every 32 prompts. SFT uses three epochs, 1e-5 learning rate, and cosine scheduling; RL reports 1.5e-6 and KL coefficient 2e-4. Maximum generation length is 10,240 for GLM-4-9B/Qwen2.5-14B and 16,384 for Qwen2.5-32B. (Appendix B.)

The declared uses are SFT, RL with verifiable outcomes, and inference-budget analysis. Evaluation uses greedy Pass@1 on MATH500, AIME 2024 (32 runs averaged for each model), Omni-MATH, and GPQA. To reproduce the method, a user would additionally need the unnamed teacher models, prompts, answer parser, bad-response rule/perplexity thresholds, exact seeds/decoding, optimizer/runtime configuration, and a mapping from released rows to construction and experiment stages. The checked GitHub repository supplies a README/LICENSE rather than this complete executable scaffold.

输入 → 构造 → 反馈 → 筛选 → 使用的流程如下。起点是 MATH-train 与 NuminaMath。每个 SFT 题目先由未具名 LLM 给出多个答案；各答案与标签比对；错误答案被要求获得 critique，正确答案被要求获得 verification；随后题目、尝试和反馈被合并为一条 chain；若只是罗列方案，则再改写为 trial-and-error 抽象。作者过滤有噪声/不准确标签及简单题。RL prompt 选择阶段对每题采样 16 个答案，仅保留 pass rate 严格位于 0 与 0.3 之间的题，形成文中所称的 30k prompt pool。（Appendix A。）

RL 对每个保留 prompt 以高温采样 K=64 条回复。最终答案正确性 reward 为 1/0，部分坏回复为 -1；reward 用 leave-one-out RLOO 归一化，加入 entropy，并用相对 EMA reference policy、跨 rollout 归一化的 KL 项。报告中每 32 个 prompt 更新一次。SFT 为 3 epochs、学习率 1e-5、cosine schedule；RL 报告学习率 1.5e-6、KL coefficient 2e-4。GLM-4-9B/Qwen2.5-14B 的最大生成长度为 10,240，Qwen2.5-32B 为 16,384。（Appendix B。）

声明的用途是 SFT、带可核验结果的 RL 和推理预算分析。评估为 MATH500、AIME 2024（每个模型平均 32 次运行）、Omni-MATH 与 GPQA 上的 greedy Pass@1。若要复现，还需未具名 teacher model、prompt、答案 parser、坏回复规则/perplexity 阈值、精确 seeds/decoding、optimizer/runtime 配置，以及发布行到构造和实验阶段的映射。检查到的 GitHub 仓库提供 README/LICENSE，而非这套完整可执行 scaffold。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main reported evidence is conditional on the authors' models, benchmarks, and greedy Pass@1 protocol. In the author repository's result table, T1 with Qwen2.5-32B reports 92.4 on MATH500, 50.6 on AIME, 49.6 on OmniMATH500, and 56.1 on GPQA; its listed SFT-only counterpart reports 83.4, 24.9, 34.6, and 49.5. These are author-reported benchmark results, not a quality audit of the released data.

Two diagnostic results are more informative for the recipe. With top-p 0.95, the reported temperature sweep for the 14B setting gives MATH500/AIME/OmniMATH values of 78.2/19.1/32.0 at 0.9, 84.6/29.0/37.8 at 1.1, 86.4/29.3/38.6 at 1.2, and 84.6/24.3/36.4 at 1.3; changing to min-p 0.05 at temperature 1.2 gives 78.8/11.5/31.6. This supports a setting-specific exploration claim, not a universal temperature rule. (Paper Table 2.)

The bad-response penalty ablation reports, at 120 RL steps, 81.2 accuracy and 1.6% overlong ratio with the penalty versus 76.4 and 16.3% without it; the no-penalty run is not reported at 160 steps. (Paper Table 3.) Figure 6 shows increasing average generated tokens on Qwen2.5-32B from roughly 2k to 7k raises AIME average from 24.3 to about 50, while MATH500 rises from 86.1 to 92.4. These observations describe the reported setup only; no independent reproduction or contamination audit was found.

主要证据受作者所用模型、benchmark 与 greedy Pass@1 协议限制。作者仓库结果表中，Qwen2.5-32B 上的 T1 报告 MATH500 92.4、AIME 50.6、OmniMATH500 49.6、GPQA 56.1；其列出的仅 SFT 对照为 83.4、24.9、34.6、49.5。这些是作者报告的 benchmark 结果，并不是对公开数据质量的审计。

两个诊断结果对理解配方更有帮助。top-p 0.95 下，14B 设置的温度扫描在 0.9、1.1、1.2、1.3 时分别报告 MATH500/AIME/OmniMATH 为 78.2/19.1/32.0、84.6/29.0/37.8、86.4/29.3/38.6、84.6/24.3/36.4；温度 1.2 改为 min-p 0.05 时为 78.8/11.5/31.6。这支持的是特定设置中的探索结论，不是通用温度法则。（论文 Table 2。）

坏回复 penalty 的消融在 120 个 RL steps 时报告：有 penalty 的 accuracy 为 81.2、overlong ratio 为 1.6%；无 penalty 时为 76.4 和 16.3%；无 penalty 的 160-step 结果未报告。（论文 Table 3。）Figure 6 显示 Qwen2.5-32B 的平均生成 token 从约 2k 增至约 7k 时，AIME 平均值从 24.3 升至约 50，而 MATH500 从 86.1 升至 92.4。这些观察只描述报告的设置；未发现独立复现或 contamination audit。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is not “no reasoning data”: outcome-reward math RL, multi-sample search, entropy/KL regularization, and test-time sampling already exist as general ingredients. T1 changes the composition and the object that is presented to SFT. Rather than keeping only successful solution traces, it asks LLMs to turn multiple attempts plus correctness-grounded critiques or verifications into one coherent, error-aware chain. It then connects that chain form to a high-temperature 64-rollout RL protocol and a long-response inference analysis.

The direction signal for reasoning-data work is therefore an interface choice: a trace may explicitly represent an attempted route and a correction while ultimate supervision remains an answer-level label. This can expose recoverable errors to a learner, but it does not establish that individual corrections are true or that the trace is faithful to an underlying model process. RLOO, normalized KL, entropy bonus, and answer checking should be treated as reported integrations, not as claims of wholly new primitives.

Before reuse, check whether the desired task has reliable final-label verification, whether malformed-response penalties will transfer, whether teacher-generated critiques are acceptable, and whether the training/evaluation corpora are separated. A comparison to process-reward or step-verifier resources must not silently equate synthetic self-verification prose with independently checked intermediate labels.

此前的基线并非“没有推理数据”：outcome-reward 数学 RL、多样本 search、entropy/KL regularization 与 test-time sampling 都是已有的一般性成分。T1 改变的是组合方式，以及交给 SFT 的对象。它不只保留成功解题轨迹，而是让 LLM 将多个尝试及基于正确性的 critique 或 verification 整合为一条连贯、显式包含错误的 chain；再将这种链形式与高温 64-rollout RL 协议和长回复 inference analysis 连接起来。

因此，对 reasoning-data 的方向信号是一种接口选择：当最终监督仍是答案级标签时，轨迹可以显式表达一次尝试及其纠正。它可能让学习者看到可恢复的错误，但不证明每一次纠正为真，也不证明该轨迹忠实反映了模型内部过程。RLOO、normalized KL、entropy bonus 和答案核验应被视为文中报告的整合，而不应被写成完全新的原语。

复用前应检查：目标任务是否有可靠的最终标签核验；坏回复 penalty 是否能迁移；能否接受 teacher 生成的 critique；训练/评估语料是否隔离。与 process-reward 或 step-verifier 资源比较时，不能悄然把合成 self-verification 文本等同于被独立核验的中间步骤标签。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The final-answer reward creates both false positives and false negatives: a completion may reach the right label through invalid reasoning, while a valid equivalent form may be rejected by an undisclosed parser. The paper's -1 penalty for repetition, excessive length, mixed language, or garbled characters can improve the reported run, but its rule and perplexity thresholds are not released; this creates a verifier-gaming and unfair-rejection risk outside the authors' setting. (Paper §3.2; Table 3.)

The synthesized chains are also not transparent process annotations. Their constituent attempts, critiques, verifier prompts, teacher identities, and merge decisions are unavailable, so hidden teacher habits and mistaken critiques cannot be audited row by row. The selection rule discards easy questions and keeps a narrow 16-sample pass-rate band, but the release does not preserve all rejected attempts or filter explanations. This can change difficulty, style, and error distributions in ways a downstream trainer cannot measure.

Artifact limitations are material. The dataset viewer reports a schema-cast error because the released files use incompatible columns. The checked README calls model weights and RL training data “coming soon,” yet the dataset revision contains rl-data.jsonl; the file name does not settle what was released. Dataset license, upstream rights, row-level provenance, benchmark-overlap analysis, executable training code, and a full configuration are unknown. Benchmark improvement should therefore not be read as proof of release quality or clean evaluation separation.

最终答案 reward 同时会产生 false positive 与 false negative：一条 completion 可能用无效推理碰巧得到正确标签；有效的等价表达也可能被未披露的 parser 拒绝。对重复、过长、混合语言或乱码回复施加 -1 的做法可以改善文中运行，但规则与 perplexity 阈值没有发布；离开作者设置后，它带来 verifier gaming 和不公平拒绝风险。（论文 §3.2；Table 3。）

合成 chain 也不是透明的过程标注。组成它的 attempts、critiques、verifier prompts、teacher identity 与 merge decision 均不可得，因而无法逐行审计隐含 teacher 习惯或错误 critique。选择规则丢弃简单题，并保留 16-sample pass rate 位于一个窄区间的题，但发布物没有保存所有被拒绝的尝试或筛选解释。这会以使用者无法量化的方式改变难度、文风和错误分布。

artifact 限制很实质。由于两个已发布文件的列不兼容，dataset viewer 报告 schema-cast error。检查到的 README 说 model weights 与 RL training data “coming soon”，但数据集 revision 又有 rl-data.jsonl；文件名不能决定究竟发布了什么。dataset license、上游权利、逐行 provenance、benchmark-overlap 分析、可执行训练代码和完整配置都是 unknown。因此，benchmark 提升不能被理解为发布质量或干净评估隔离的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Reuse class: reading/audit reference and recipe baseline; training reuse blocked pending verification. The paper can guide an experiment that compares clean successful-only SFT traces with synthesized attempt–critique–merge traces while holding the final-answer verifier constant. It also provides a testable RL baseline: vary rollout count and temperature, record full completions and per-rollout rewards, and compare RLOO/entropy/KL variants under the same answer parser.

For the assigned rollout/search test-time trace track, use it to separate two questions often conflated: does more sampling create useful exploration during RL, and does more generated text help at inference? Reproduce the prefix-summary curve only after recording truncation points, base model, prompt, and answer extraction. Measure accuracy together with response length, repetition, verifier disagreement, accepted/rejected equivalent answers, and compute; otherwise a length or formatting policy may masquerade as reasoning improvement.

For data curation, require a repair checklist before any direct use of the public files: identify which file is SFT versus RL and enumerate rows; pin the revision; obtain source/license manifests; release parser and penalty details; publish attempts, filter outcomes, and generation lineage; run benchmark-overlap checks. The current repository is suitable for inspecting a release discrepancy, not for assuming a turnkey model/data reproduction.

复用等级：阅读/审计参考与 recipe baseline；在补齐核验前，训练复用被阻塞。 该论文可指导这样的对照实验：在固定最终答案 verifier 的条件下，比较只含成功解答的 SFT trace 与“尝试–critique–合并”的合成 trace。它还提供可检验的 RL baseline：改变 rollout 数和温度，记录完整 completion 与每个 rollout reward，并在同一答案 parser 下比较 RLOO/entropy/KL 变体。

对指定的 rollout/search test-time trace track，它有助于拆开两个常被混淆的问题：更多 sampling 是否在 RL 中带来有用探索？更多生成文本是否在 inference 时有帮助？只有在记录 truncation point、base model、prompt 与答案提取方式后，才应复现 prefix-summary 曲线。除 accuracy 外，还应测量回复长度、重复、verifier disagreement、被接受/拒绝的等价答案和计算量；否则长度或格式策略可能伪装成推理提升。

进行数据策展时，直接使用公开文件前应完成修复清单：辨明哪个文件是 SFT、哪个是 RL 并枚举行；固定 revision；获得来源/license manifest；发布 parser 与 penalty 细节；发布 attempts、filter outcomes 与生成谱系；执行 benchmark-overlap 检查。当前仓库适合检查一次发布不一致，而不适合假设可直接复现模型/数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1 and Appendix A together: the important data transformation is attempts + label-grounded critique/verification → merged chain, not simply “synthetic CoT.”
  • Read §3.2 with Appendix B: K=64, RLOO, high temperature, entropy, normalized KL, and the -1 bad-response penalty jointly define the reported RL behavior.
  • Table 2 is the guardrail against a simplistic “higher temperature is better” reading; its evidence is a finite sweep in one reported setting.
  • Table 3 is the guardrail against treating length control as cosmetic: the penalty changes both overlong ratio and reported accuracy, but its detector is not auditable from the release.
  • Read Figure 6 separately from RL results. Prefix truncation/summarization is an analysis of a generated response, not evidence that the dataset supplies a search tree or a generally valid test-time strategy.

Easy misreadings: the public rl-data.jsonl filename does not by itself contradict or resolve the README's “coming soon” statement; inspect its schema and release documentation. Likewise, a 92.4 MATH500 result is not a data-license, provenance, or contamination certificate. Pair this card with a step-verifier/process-reward card when deciding whether intermediate correctness—not just answer correctness—is needed.

• 应将 §3.1 与 Appendix A 一起读：关键数据变换是“attempts + 基于标签的 critique/verification → merged chain”，而不只是“synthetic CoT”。
  • 应将 §3.2 与 Appendix B 一起读：K=64、RLOO、高温、entropy、normalized KL 和 -1 坏回复 penalty 共同定义了报告的 RL 行为。
  • Table 2 防止把结论误读成“温度越高越好”；其证据只是一个报告设置内的有限扫描。
  • Table 3 防止把长度控制当作表面处理：penalty 同时改变 overlong ratio 和报告 accuracy，但其 detector 无法从发布物审计。
  • Figure 6 应与 RL 结果分开看。prefix truncation/summarization 是对已生成回复的分析，不证明数据集提供 search tree 或普适的 test-time 策略。

容易误读之处：公开的 rl-data.jsonl 文件名本身不能反驳或解决 README 中“coming soon”的表述；必须检查其 schema 和发布文档。同样，92.4 的 MATH500 结果不是 data license、provenance 或 contamination 的证书。若决策需要的是中间步骤正确性而不仅是答案正确性，应将本卡与 step-verifier/process-reward 卡片配套阅读。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Hou, Zhenyu, Xin Lv, Rui Lu, Jiajie Zhang, Yujiang Li, Zijun Yao, Juanzi Li, Jie Tang, and Yuxiao Dong. 2025. “T1: Advancing Language Model Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning and Inference Scaling.” Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 267:23976–24003.

Verified paper: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/hou25e.html Verified OpenReview record: https://openreview.net/forum?id=tnxONP8zTE Verified author repository: https://github.com/THUDM/T1 Verified dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/T1

Artifact note: the dataset revision observed on 2026-07-23 was 137595d2bcb16ef9791d67f3a6753acfe6ab30cd, with sft.jsonl and rl-data.jsonl. The repository is MIT, has no GitHub release, and its README still marks model weights and RL training data as coming soon; no model artifact is linked here.

Hou, Zhenyu, Xin Lv, Rui Lu, Jiajie Zhang, Yujiang Li, Zijun Yao, Juanzi Li, Jie Tang, and Yuxiao Dong. 2025. “T1: Advancing Language Model Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning and Inference Scaling.” Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 267:23976–24003.

已核验论文：https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/hou25e.html 已核验 OpenReview 记录：https://openreview.net/forum?id=tnxONP8zTE 已核验作者仓库：https://github.com/THUDM/T1 已核验数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/zai-org/T1

artifact 说明：2026-07-23 观察到的数据集 revision 为 137595d2bcb16ef9791d67f3a6753acfe6ab30cd，含 sft.jsonl 与 rl-data.jsonl。该仓库为 MIT、没有 GitHub release，而 README 仍将 model weights 和 RL training data 标记为 coming soon；本卡不链接任何 model artifact。

value.html: The paper uses publicly available MATH-train and NuminaMath questions. MATH uses its official answers; for NuminaMath, an LLM extracts a concise final answer. The paper reports roughly 12,000 SFT questions and 30,000 remaining RL questions after label-quality and difficulty filtering, but supplies no immutable per-row upstream URL or rights manifest.

value_zh.html: 论文使用公开可用的 MATH-train 与 NuminaMath 问题。MATH 使用其官方答案；对 NuminaMath，LLM 提取简洁最终答案。论文报告在标签质量与难度过滤之后约 12,000 个 SFT 问题与 30,000 个剩余 RL 问题，但未提供不可变的逐行上游 URL 或权利清单。

value.html: The intended SFT object is a mathematical problem plus a synthesized long chain of thought containing attempted solutions, critiques or self-checks, and a final answer. At dataset revision 137595d2bcb16ef9791d67f3a6753acfe6ab30cd, sft.jsonl begins with prompt and response fields while rl-data.jsonl begins with source, problem, and answer fields; no dataset card explains their exact correspondence to paper splits or experiments.

value_zh.html: 预期 SFT 对象是数学问题加合成的长思维链，含尝试解答、批评或自检以及最终答案。在数据集修订 137595d2bcb16ef9791d67f3a6753acfe6ab30cd，sft.jsonl 以 prompt 与 response 字段开始，而 rl-data.jsonl 以 source、problem 与 answer 字段开始；无数据集卡片解释其与论文划分或实验的精确对应。

value.html: For SFT, multiple responses from different LLMs are judged against the ground-truth label, critiqued or verified by an LLM, and merged by another LLM into one trial-and-error/self-verification chain. The identities, versions, prompts, and decoding settings of those LLMs are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 对 SFT，来自不同 LLMs 的多个响应对照标准标签评判，由 LLM 批评或验证，并由另一 LLM 合并为一条试错/自我验证链。那些 LLMs 的身份、版本、提示与解码设置未披露。

value.html: This is text-only mathematical reasoning rather than an external tool environment. Correctness is judged from a final answer against a ground-truth label; the paper evaluates AIME 2024, Omni-MATH, MATH500, and GPQA.

value_zh.html: 这是纯文本数学推理而非外部工具环境。正确性由最终答案对照标准标签评判；论文评测 AIME 2024、Omni-MATH、MATH500 与 GPQA。

value.html: The reported RL reward is 1 for a ground-truth-correct answer and 0 otherwise. Responses detected as repetitive, excessively long, mixed-language, or containing garbled characters receive -1 through rule detection and a perplexity filter. RLOO uses leave-one-out normalized rewards; a normalized KL term against an EMA reference policy is also reported.

value_zh.html: 所报告 RL 奖励对标准正确答案为 1，否则为 0。被检测为重复、过长、混合语言或含乱码字符的响应通过规则检测与困惑度过滤器得到 -1。RLOO 使用留一法归一化奖励；亦报告相对 EMA 参考策略的归一化 KL 项。

value.html: An RL completion is reward-positive when its final answer matches the ground truth under the authors' answer-evaluation procedure. The exact parser, normalization rules, per-item verifier outputs, and failure logs are not released.

value_zh.html: 当最终答案在作者答案评测程序下匹配标准答案时，RL 补全为奖励正。精确解析器、归一化规则、逐项验证器输出与失败日志未发布。

value.html: Reported experiments use GLM-4-9B and Qwen2.5 14B/32B variants. The paper does not provide a released T1 model weight at the checked author repository.

value_zh.html: 所报告实验使用 GLM-4-9B 与 Qwen2.5 14B/32B 变体。论文未在所核验作者仓库提供已发布的 T1 模型权重。

value.html: Multiple unnamed LLMs generate attempts, critique or verify them, and merge them into SFT chains. Their identities and versions are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 多个未具名 LLMs 生成尝试、批评或验证它们，并将其合并为 SFT 链。其身份与版本未披露。

value.html: For each question, collect multiple candidate answers; compare each with the label; solicit a critique for an incorrect answer or verification for a correct one; merge problem, attempts, and feedback into a chain; rewrite chains that merely enumerate approaches into an abstracted trial-and-error pattern.

value_zh.html: 对每个问题，收集多个候选答案；将每个与标签比较；对错误答案征求批评，对正确答案征求验证；将问题、尝试与反馈合并为一条链；将仅枚举方法的链改写为抽象试错模式。

value.html: RL generates K=64 responses per prompt at high temperature (the main sweep includes temperatures 0.9, 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3 with top-p 0.95). The policy gradient update is performed every 32 prompts. Seeds, exact prompt templates, and all decoding parameters are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: RL 在高温度下每个提示生成 K=64 个响应（主扫描包括温度 0.9、1.1、1.2 与 1.3，且 top-p 0.95）。策略梯度更新每 32 个提示执行一次。种子、精确提示模板与全部解码参数未披露。

value.html: 64 RL responses per prompt; 16 responses per question for the reported RL-prompt selection stage.

value_zh.html: 每个提示 64 个 RL 响应；所报告 RL 提示选择阶段每个问题 16 个响应。

value.html: High-temperature sampling is central to the reported RL recipe; Table 2 evaluates 0.9, 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3 with top-p 0.95. The selected universal temperature and per-model settings are not fully disclosed.

value_zh.html: 高温采样是所报告 RL 配方的核心；表 2 评测 0.9、1.1、1.2 与 1.3，且 top-p 0.95。所选通用温度与逐模型设置未完全披露。

value.html: Construction removes inaccurate/noisy labels and easy questions. For RL, 16 responses are sampled per question and prompts with pass rate in (0, 0.3) are retained. During RL, malformed or undesirable long responses receive -1 using rules and perplexity. Exact source-filter decisions and released-row memberships are unavailable.

value_zh.html: 构建移除不准确/噪声标签与简单问题。对 RL，每个问题采样 16 个响应，并保留通过率在 (0, 0.3) 的提示。在 RL 期间，畸形或不期望的长响应用规则与困惑度得到 -1。精确来源过滤决定与已发布行成员资格不可得。

value.html: Training/inference maximum generation lengths are 10,240 tokens for GLM-4-9B and Qwen2.5-14B, and 16,384 for Qwen2.5-32B. The separate inference-scaling analysis truncates a long completion at 10%-increment prefixes and asks the base model to summarize/finalize each prefix.

value_zh.html: 训练/推断最大生成长度对 GLM-4-9B 与 Qwen2.5-14B 为 10,240 tokens，对 Qwen2.5-32B 为 16,384。单独的推断扩展分析在 10%-increment 前缀处截断长补全，并要求基础模型对每个前缀做摘要/收尾。

value.html: SFT runs for three epochs with learning rate 1e-5 and cosine scheduling. RL uses RLOO, learning rate 1.5e-6, KL coefficient 2e-4, reward normalization, entropy bonus, and an EMA reference-policy anchor. Full optimizer configuration, infrastructure, and training code are not released in the checked repository.

value_zh.html: SFT 运行三个 epoch，学习率 1e-5，余弦调度。RL 使用 RLOO、学习率 1.5e-6、KL 系数 2e-4、奖励归一化、熵奖励与 EMA 参考策略锚。完整优化器配置、基础设施与训练代码未在所核验仓库发布。

value.html: Public MATH-train and NuminaMath questions feed approximately 12k SFT and 30k RL prompts after filtering. The release provides two JSONL files but no row-level upstream source manifest, deduplication report, or reconciliation with these paper counts.

value_zh.html: 公开 MATH-train 与 NuminaMath 问题在过滤后供给约 12k 条 SFT 与 30k 条 RL 提示。发布提供两个 JSONL 文件，但无行级上游来源清单、去重报告或与这些论文计数的对账。

value.html: The paper distinguishes SFT construction data, RL prompts, and four evaluation benchmarks, but the Hugging Face repository has no documented train/dev/test split or release-to-experiment manifest. The dataset viewer fails to build a combined schema because the two JSONL files have incompatible columns.

value_zh.html: 论文区分 SFT 构建数据、RL 提示与四个评测基准，但 Hugging Face 仓库无文档化的 train/dev/test 划分或发布到实验清单。数据集查看器因两个 JSONL 文件列不兼容而无法构建合并 schema。

value.html: Unknown. Since row-level upstream provenance and deduplication decisions are unavailable, independent overlap checks against the reported benchmarks cannot be completed from the release.

value_zh.html: 未知。由于行级上游出处与去重决定不可得，无法从发布完成对照所报告基准的独立重叠检查。

value.html: Unknown. The paper reports benchmark evaluation but no corpus-level overlap or model-pretraining contamination audit between MATH/NuminaMath-derived training prompts and MATH500, AIME 2024, Omni-MATH, or GPQA.

value_zh.html: 未知。论文报告基准评测，但无 MATH/NuminaMath 派生训练提示与 MATH500、AIME 2024、Omni-MATH 或 GPQA 之间的语料级重叠或模型预训练污染审计。

value.html: The construction recipe retains RL prompts with 16-sample pass rate in (0, 0.3), and RL penalizes some undesirable outputs with -1. It does not release all attempts, per-attempt reward/verifier decisions, filter reasons, or a complete rejected-sample manifest.

value_zh.html: 构建配方保留 16 样本通过率在 (0, 0.3) 的 RL 提示，且 RL 对某些不期望输出处以 -1。它不发布全部尝试、逐次尝试的奖励/验证器决定、过滤原因或完整拒绝样本清单。

items: Final-answer reward can miss reasoning errors that happen to end in the correct answer and can reject semantically valid equivalent answers when parsing or normalization fails.
Rule/perplexity penalties can falsely flag legitimate long, multilingual, or unusual mathematical text; thresholds and row-level decisions are not released.
Synthesized SFT chains may inherit hidden teacher-model preferences, and their constituent attempts/critiques are not independently auditable.
The viewer's schema-cast error and absent data card prevent straightforward inspection; file names alone do not prove that the public files reproduce the paper's SFT/RL data.
No benchmark-overlap or contamination audit is reported, so benchmark gains are not evidence of data quality or clean separation.
最终答案奖励可能漏掉碰巧以正确答案结束的推理错误，并可能在解析或归一化失败时拒绝语义有效的等价答案。
规则/困惑度惩罚可能错误标记合法的长、多语言或异常数学文本；阈值与行级决定未发布。
合成 SFT 链可能继承隐藏的教师模型偏好，且其组成尝试/批评无法独立审计。
查看器的 schema-cast 错误与缺失数据卡片妨碍直接检查；仅文件名不能证明公开文件复现论文的 SFT/RL 数据。
未报告基准重叠或污染审计，因此基准增益不是数据质量或干净分离的证据。

value.html: The checked GitHub repository is MIT. The Hugging Face dataset page/API exposes no dataset license or upstream-rights statement; the MIT repository license does not establish redistribution rights for MATH, NuminaMath, generated traces, or labels.

value_zh.html: 所核验 GitHub 仓库为 MIT。Hugging Face 数据集页/API 未暴露数据集许可或上游权利声明；MIT 仓库许可并不确立 MATH、NuminaMath、生成痕迹或标签的再分发权利。

value.html: MATH-train or NuminaMath question -> label extraction/checking -> multiple LLM attempts -> correct/incorrect critique or verification -> LLM merge/rewrite into SFT chain; separately, filtered prompt -> 64 RL completions -> answer reward, bad-response penalty, RLOO/KL update. Release-row-to-stage mapping is not documented.

value_zh.html: MATH-train 或 NuminaMath 问题 -> 标签提取/检查 -> 多次 LLM 尝试 -> 正确/不正确批评或验证 -> LLM 合并/改写为 SFT 链；另外，过滤后的提示 -> 64 条 RL 补全 -> 答案奖励、不良响应惩罚、RLOO/KL 更新。发布行到阶段映射未文档化。
